name: Gulf / US–Iran war
value: Tankers hit in Hormuz; US blockade on
summary: Iran's attacks on shipping and Gulf states continue; Trump says on 22 Nov strikes resume after New Year unless a deal
state: Iran fired at Bahrain on 22 Nov and UKMTO said two tankers were hit in Hormuz that day; Trump said on 22 Nov the US would resume military action after the New Year unless a deal was reached (Gulf News). More than 25 tankers were hit in the week to 24 Nov (Al Jazeera). The US Treasury added sanctions on Iran's financial networks on 23 Nov, and state media said on 23 Nov no tanker convoy had set out to break the US blockade (The National). Attacks on shipping and Gulf states keep the Alert.
for_you: Follow FCDO travel advice for Iran, Bahrain, Kuwait, the UAE and the Gulf, which is changing at short notice.
rubric_hit: Attacks on Gulf shipping and states, Hormuz materially impeded = Alert

why: Direct hostilities between Iran and the US or Israel threaten Gulf energy infrastructure, the Strait of Hormuz and the wider region.
drivers: Strikes and retaliation, attacks on shipping and Gulf states, mediation and ceasefire talks, US force posture.

rubric.alert: Active strikes between states, attacks on Gulf energy infrastructure or shipping, or the Strait of Hormuz substantially closed.
rubric.watch: A ceasefire or stalemate with sporadic strikes, or credible threats of renewed strikes.
rubric.normal: No direct state-on-state hostilities; diplomacy active.
